prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Prakash V., Ashok bhai, Mahesh bhai, Prakash bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 6:00 pm and 6:58 pm: 11 messages
- between 6:58 pm and 8:00 pm: 14 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "6:02 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Haan bhai sab log shaam ko mil rahe ho kya?"},
  {"time": "6:08 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Main toh dukaan par hi hoon abhi."},
  {"time": "6:15 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Chai peene aate hain thodi der mein."},
  {"time": "6:21 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Purana hisaab bhi dekh lena sab log."},
  {"time": "6:27 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Kuch baaki hai kya abhi mere taraf se?"},
  {"time": "6:33 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Nahi tera sab chuka diya tha waise."},
  {"time": "6:39 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Pehle wali chai ka chhutta kiske paas gaya tha?"},
  {"time": "6:44 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Woh toh main dekh lunga, tum log bas aa jao."},
  {"time": "6:50 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Sahi hai, aate waqt kuch naashta leta aaoon?"},
  {"time": "6:54 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Haan samosa le aana sabke liye."},
  {"time": "6:57 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Main bhi nikal hi raha hoon abhi ghar se."},
  {"time": "7:01 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Dukaan ke baahar hi milte hain phir."},
  {"time": "7:06 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Theek hai main thodi der mein pahunch raha hoon."},
  {"time": "7:12 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Sab log hisaab ki diary bhi saath lana."},
  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Diary toh mere paas hi rakhi hai."},
  {"time": "7:25 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Pura mamla nipat gaya tha na?"},
  {"time": "7:31 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Haan sab chukta ho gaya tha."},
  {"time": "7:36 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Chai wala aagya hai, jaldi aao sab."},
  {"time": "7:41 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Main bas raste mein hoon, aagaya."},
  {"time": "7:45 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Aaj ka kharcha kaun dekh raha hai?"},
  {"time": "7:49 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Aaj mera number hai, tension mat lo."},
  {"time": "7:52 pm", "sender": "Ashok bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, agli baar main dekh lunga."},
  {"time": "7:55 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Sab aagaye hain kya abhi?"},
  {"time": "7:58 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Haan bas Prakash V raste mein hai."},
  {"time": "8:00 pm", "sender": "Prakash V.", "text": "Main bhi pahunch gaya hoon baahar hi hoon."}
]
